battle.name: 朝鮮戰爭
battle.brief: 朝鮮戰爭於1950年6月在朝鮮半島爆發，交戰以三八線南北為主要戰區，英國陸軍等聯合國部隊與朝鮮人民軍對抗。英國陸軍配備的恩菲爾德步槍（Enfield rifle）早在1858年已列入服役，屬於當時步兵班制式單兵火器，負責支撐地面步兵作戰，並構成步兵班的重要射擊武器。

kit.name: 恩菲爾德步槍
kit.history: 恩菲爾德步槍是英國陸軍步兵班的制式步槍，位於連隊步兵武器系統核心，提供單兵射擊火力，並由步兵射手操作。

countries: 交戰架構可分三層。第一層是朝鮮民主主義人民共和國與其朝鮮人民軍，對面則是大韓民國軍隊；雙方自1948年分別建政後，便以北緯三十八度附近的軍事分界線對峙。第二層是依聯合國安全理事會第八十三號決議建立的聯合國軍，由美國承擔主要地面兵力，英國、加拿大、澳洲、紐西蘭、法國、南非、比利時、荷蘭、希臘、土耳其、泰國、菲律賓與哥倫比亞等國提供分遣隊，盧森堡亦派出後續小分隊；第七十七特遣艦隊等海空單位負責封鎖、運輸與空中支援。第三層是1950年10月下旬開始參戰的中國人民志願軍，以及提供武器、訓練和後勤協助的蘇聯；蘇方另在中國東北組織以蘇聯飛行員操作的米格十五航空部隊。上述安排使戰事由南北韓交戰，迅速變成美國主導、聯合國多國部隊與中蘇兩方面直接介入的國際戰爭。
countriesEn: The belligerent structure had three layers. First were the armed forces of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea, led by the Korean People’s Army, opposing the armed forces of the Republic of Korea; after both states were established in 1948, their forces confronted one another across a military boundary near the thirty-eighth parallel. Second was the United Nations force authorized by Security Council Resolution 83. The United States supplied most of its ground strength, while Britain, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, France, South Africa, Belgium, the Netherlands, Greece, Turkey, Thailand, the Philippines, and Colombia provided contingents, with Luxembourg later sending a small detachment. Surface and air units such as Task Force 77 conducted blockade, transport, and air-support operations. Third were the Chinese People’s Volunteers, who entered from late October 1950, and the Soviet Union, which supplied weapons, training, and logistical assistance. Soviet-organized MiG-15 units also operated from northeastern China with Soviet pilots. These arrangements turned a Korean civil conflict into an international war involving a United States-led multinational force and direct Chinese and Soviet military involvement.
people: 關鍵決策與指揮者分屬不同層級。美國總統杜魯門在北韓越過三十八度線後批准空海軍參戰，國務卿艾奇遜主張以聯合國框架援助大韓民國；麥克阿瑟被任命為駐韓美軍最高司令官，隨後擔任聯合國軍總司令，並建立以參謀長為核心的指揮體系。金日成負責策劃朝鮮人民軍的攻勢，李承晚則主持大韓民國政府的求援與戰時行政。中國方面，毛澤東決定以中國人民志願軍名義出兵，彭德懷任志願軍司令員兼政治委員，周恩來參與中朝與中蘇的協調；史達林掌握蘇聯對北韓和中國的援助及空軍部署。前線最具影響力的聯合國指揮官包括第八軍司令沃克、第十軍司令阿爾蒙德與第七師師長迪恩；沃克於1950年12月在巡查時觸雷身亡，李奇微在12月26日接掌第八軍。麥克阿瑟其後於1951年4月被解除職務，李奇微接任聯合國軍最高指揮官。
peopleEn: The principal decision-makers and commanders operated at different levels. After North Korean forces crossed the thirty-eighth parallel, President Harry Truman authorized American air and naval participation, while Secretary of State Dean Acheson advocated supporting the Republic of Korea through the United Nations. Douglas MacArthur was appointed commanding general of the United States forces in Korea and subsequently became Commander in Chief, United Nations Command, establishing a staff-centered command structure. Kim Il Sung directed the Korean People’s Army’s offensive, while Syngman Rhee headed the Republic of Korea government’s requests for assistance and wartime administration. On the Chinese side, Mao Zedong decided to deploy the Chinese People’s Volunteers, Peng Dehuai served as commander and political commissar, and Zhou Enlai participated in coordination among Beijing, Pyongyang, and Moscow. Joseph Stalin directed Soviet assistance to North Korea and China and the deployment of Soviet aviation. The most influential United Nations commanders in the field included Eighth Army’s Walton Walker, X Corps’ Edward Almond, and 7th Infantry Division’s William Dean. Walker was killed by a mine while inspecting the front on December 1950, 1950, and Matthew Ridgway took command of Eighth Army on December 26. Truman relieved MacArthur in April 1951, after which Ridgway succeeded him as Commander in Chief, United Nations Command.
kits: 1950年能投入戰場的裝備具有鮮明的年代特徵。美國與聯合國地面部隊使用M1加蘭德步槍、M1卡賓槍、湯姆森衝鋒槍、M3衝鋒槍、勃朗寧M1919A4機槍與M二點五〇重機槍，炮兵主要配備M一八一直徑八十一毫米迫擊砲、M2一〇五毫米榴彈砲及M一一五毫米榴彈砲；英軍和聯邦部隊另有二十五磅砲與四點五英寸迫擊砲。裝甲包括M4雪曼、M24潘興、M26潘興，以及1950年開始列裝的M46潘興；英國與聯邦部隊使用MK3-centurion坦克、彗星巡洋坦克和雪曼坦克。運輸主要依靠M35二點五噸卡車、M54十噸卡車，以及從日本港口通往釜山和前線的鐵路。空中武器包括C-47、C-46、F6F-5、F4U-5、F9F獅子魚、B-26和B-29。北韓軍裝備莫辛納甘M1891/30步槍、SVT-40、AK-47、PPSh-41、DP-28輕機槍、T-34/85坦克、ZIS-3七六點二毫米火炮、M1910/30一二二毫米榴彈砲、ML-20一五二毫米榴彈砲及M1912/38一二〇毫米迫擊砲，並使用ZIS-5與ZIS-150卡車、Yak-9和Il-2飛機。中國志願軍使用蘇制武器、Type 38步槍及1950年列裝的Type 50一二二毫米榴彈砲。不同部隊並非共用同一套膛徑，實際供應包含點三〇六、口徑點四五ACP、英國點三零三、七點六二乘五四毫米R與七點九二乘五七毫米等彈藥，因此後勤必須分庫儲存、分批前送。
kitsEn: The equipment available in 1950 carried the unmistakable characteristics of its period. American and United Nations ground units used the M1 Garand rifle, M1 carbine, Thompson submachine gun, M3 submachine gun, Browning M1919A4 machine gun, and Browning M2 .50-caliber machine gun. Their artillery centered on the M1 81 mm mortar, M2 105 mm howitzer, and M1 155 mm howitzer, while British and Commonwealth units also used the 25-pounder and 4.5-inch mortar. Armor included M4 Sherman, M24 Pershing, M26 Pershing, and the M46 Patton, which entered production in 1950. British and Commonwealth forces fielded Centurion Mk 3, Comet cruiser tanks, and Shermans. Logistics depended on M35 2.5-ton trucks, M54 10-ton trucks, and railways running from Japanese ports to Pusan and the forward areas. Aircraft included the C-47, C-46, F6F-5 Hellcat, F4U-5 Corsair, F9F Panther, B-26 Marauder, and B-29 Superfortress. North Korean forces used Mosin-Nagant M1891/30 rifles, SVT-40 rifles, AK-47 rifles, PPSh-41 submachine guns, DP-28 light machine guns, T-34/85 tanks, ZIS-3 76.2 mm guns, M1910/30 122 mm howitzers, ML-20 152 mm howitzers, and M1912/38 120 mm mortars. They also employed ZIS-5 and ZIS-150 trucks, Yak-9 fighters, and Il-2 ground-attack aircraft. Chinese forces used Soviet weapons, Type 38 rifles, and the Type 50 122 mm howitzer placed in service in 1950. Units did not share a single ammunition standard. Stocks included .30-06, .45 ACP, British .303, 7.62×54 mmR, and 7.92×57 mm, requiring separate storage and forward distribution.
tactics: 1950年6月25日，朝鮮人民軍以多個師團在約二百五十公里寬的正面越過三十八度線，先行炮火準備，再由步兵分批推進，並利用繳獲的大韓民國軍裝備迅速擴張戰果；漢城於6月28日失守，韓軍沿主要公路向釜山地區撤退。聯合國地面部隊於7月抵達後，先以英美小股部隊守住交通線，其中史密斯特遣隊在7月21日至22日的多寶洞戰鬥中首度與北韓軍正面交鋒；8月北韓軍包圍釜山，聯軍依靠反斜面工事、炮兵射界與反坦克部隊在洛東江地區形成周邊防線。8月19日至9月18日，聯軍在洛東江突出部反覆阻止北韓軍突破。麥克阿瑟於9月15日在仁川登陸，由美軍海軍陸戰隊與大韓民國第一師協同奪取港口和 airfield，當日突破北韓軍 flanks；聯軍隨後奪回漢城，並於10月7日進入平壤，但補給線仍由釜山經鐵路、卡車和空運維持。中國人民志願軍於10月下旬越過鴨綠江，第十三兵團先在溫井和清川江作戰；11月下旬，第三十九兵團在長津湖對抗美軍第一騎兵師、第七師、英國第二十九旅及美軍海軍陸戰隊一部。道路狹窄、嚴寒、燃料不足與連續作戰削弱攻勢後，志願軍分批撤出接戰區，聯軍則以_commando_與_home-by-Christmas_兩項作戰打通走廊，並由海路和公路完成興南撤退。1951年1月25日，李奇微以第八軍發動_thunderbolt_，29日再奪漢城；第十軍於1月31日發動_ripper_。中國第五次戰役隨後迫使聯軍在部分戰線後撤，聯軍依靠炮兵、裝甲與後勤補給至4月底才把戰線大致拉回三十八度線附近。1951年7月板門店談判開始後，前線仍以縱深炮兵、封鎖和空軍作戰維持，直至1953年停火。
tacticsEn: On June 25, 1950, several Korean People’s Army divisions crossed the thirty-eighth parallel across a front roughly 250 kilometers wide. After a preliminary artillery barrage, infantry advanced in successive waves and exploited captured Republic of Korea equipment to extend their reach. Seoul fell on June 28, and Republic of Korea forces withdrew toward Pusan along the principal roads. When United Nations ground units arrived in July, small British and American formations first secured the communications network. Task Force Smith fought North Korean troops at Tabu-dong on July 21 and 22, marking the first American ground engagement. North Korean forces surrounded Pusan in August, but United Nations troops used reverse-slope positions, overlapping artillery, and tank-destroyer units to hold the Naktong Bulge from August 19 to September 18. MacArthur landed at Inchon on September 15, where United States Marines and the Republic of Korea 1st Division secured the harbor and nearby airfield. The landing broke the North Korean flanks. United Nations forces retook Seoul and entered Pyongyang on October 7, but their supply line still ran from Pusan through railways, trucks, and airlift. Chinese People’s Volunteers crossed the Yalu in late October, with the 13th Army Corps fighting at Onjong and along the Ch’ongch’on River. In late November, the Chinese 39th Army Corps confronted the U.S. 1st Cavalry Division, 7th Infantry Division, British 29th Brigade, and elements of the U.S. Marine Corps at the Chosin Reservoir. Narrow roads, severe cold, fuel shortages, and continuous fighting reduced the Chinese offensive, after which the forces withdrew from immediate contact. Operations Commando and Home by Christmas opened corridors for the United Nations withdrawal, and the Hungnam evacuation was completed by sea and road. On January 25, 1951, Ridgway launched Operation Thunderbolt with Eighth Army; Seoul was retaken on January 29, and X Corps began Operation Ripper on January 31. China’s Fifth Campaign then pushed parts of the United Nations line backward. Artillery, armor, and resupply allowed the United Nations to restore the front near the thirty-eighth parallel by the end of April. Negotiations opened at Panmunjom in July 1951, but combat continued through deep artillery preparations, blockade, and air operations until the ceasefire in 1953.
data: 可核對的時間節點依序為1950年6月25日北韓軍越線、6月28日漢城失守、9月15日仁川登陸、9月27日聯軍重返漢城、10月7日進入平壤、11月下旬長津湖戰役爆發、12月興南撤離，以及1951年1月25日_thunderbolt_開始、1月29日漢城光復、1月31日_ripper_開始；1953年7月27日簽署停戰協定。後勤上，釜山港是1950年秋季最主要的進口與轉運港，仁川港啟用後分擔港口作業，後方基地則設於日本；鐵路把彈藥、燃料、糧食與車輛送往大邱等轉運點，再由M35二點五噸卡車和M54十噸卡車送往各師 前線彈藥庫。北韓初期曾利用大韓民國軍被繳獲的軍火庫、卡車與通訊器材，這批存量支持了最初數月的推進。聯軍各國則須分別管理點三〇六、點四五ACP、點三零三、七點六二乘五四毫米R與七點九二乘五七毫米等不同彈藥，炮兵以一〇五毫米炮彈和八十一毫米迫擊炮彈為主要消耗品。道路中斷時使用C-47與C-46空運，傷兵由機動外科醫院與後送車輛逐級送往後方。六月至九月的季風暴雨、十二月的積雪和道路結冰反覆降低運輸速度。美國國防部戰後核定的美軍死亡總數為36,574人；其他交戰方的總數在疾病死亡、失聯推定死亡及作戰死亡口徑上並不一致，因此不能把不同來源直接相加。
dataEn: The verifiable chronology runs from the North Korean crossing on June 25, 1950, through the fall of Seoul on June 28, the Inchon landing on September 15, the retaking of Seoul on September 27, the entry into Pyongyang on October 7, the opening of the Chosin Reservoir fighting in late November, and the Hungnam evacuation in December. It continues with the start of Operation Thunderbolt on January 25, 1951, the recapture of Seoul on January 29, the start of Operation Ripper on January 31, and the signing of the armistice on July 27, 1953. Logistically, Pusan was the principal receiving and transshipment port during the autumn of 1950, while Inchon assumed part of the port workload after its capture. Major rear bases were located in Japan. Railways carried ammunition, fuel, food, and vehicles to transshipment points such as Taegu, from which M35 2.5-ton and M54 10-ton trucks distributed supplies to divisional ammunition dumps. North Korean forces initially used captured Republic of Korea ammunition depots, trucks, and communications equipment, extending the reach of their early advance. United Nations units separately managed .30-06, .45 ACP, .303, 7.62×54 mmR, and 7.92×57 mm ammunition. Their principal artillery consumption consisted of 105 mm shells and 81 mm mortar bombs. C-47 and C-46 aircraft were used when roads were cut, while mobile surgical hospitals and evacuation vehicles formed the casualty-handling chain. Monsoon rains from June through September and snow and ice in December repeatedly slowed road transport. The U.S. Defense Department’s postwar count of American military deaths was 36,574. Totals for the other belligerents used different definitions for disease deaths, missing presumed dead, and combat deaths and cannot be directly added.
cause: 直接成因為朝鮮人民軍在1950年6月25日對大韓民國發動有組織的全面進攻，但衝突的根源形成於戰後數年。1945年日本投降後，蘇聯與美國分別接管北方與南方，軍界沿北緯三十八度線劃分；1948年南北兩套政權成立，蘇聯和美國駐軍相繼撤離，留下大量沿線軍備、徵兵與巡邏爭端。1949年至1950年間，邊界槍擊、游擊與滲透事件持續增加。北韓得到蘇聯的坦克、火炮、訓練和工業支持，大韓民國則由美國提供武器與援助，但初期重裝備和兵力不足以同時守住廣闊國土。金日成制訂的計畫以速決方式突破韓軍防線，奪取漢城，再向釜山推進，公開目的與實際部署均指向消滅南韓政府並統一半島。聯合國安全理事會先在6月25日以第八十二號決議譴責武裝越線，7月7日再以第八十三號決議授權會員國提供軍事援助；美國隨後依此派遣空海軍與地面部隊。聯軍在仁川登陸後向北推進並逼近中朝邊境，加上第十九航空隊等空中力量進入中國東北，使戰爭進一步跨境；北京於10月決定以志願軍名義參戰，蘇聯則加強空軍與後勤援助，遂使原本的北方攻勢變成長期消耗戰。
causeEn: The immediate cause was the organized full-scale North Korean attack against the Republic of Korea on June 25, 1950, although the underlying confrontation had developed during the preceding postwar years. After Japan surrendered in 1945, Soviet and American forces occupied the northern and southern zones, with the military boundary established near the thirty-eighth parallel. Separate regimes were established in 1948, and Soviet and American troops withdrew in sequence, leaving extensive forces, mobilization systems, and recurring patrol disputes along the border. Shootings, incursions, and infiltration increased during 1949 and 1950. North Korea received Soviet tanks, artillery, training, and industrial support. The Republic of Korea received American weapons and assistance, but its initial heavy-weapon strength and manpower could not cover the entire territory. Kim Il Sung’s plan sought a rapid breakthrough through the Republic of Korea lines, the capture of Seoul, and a drive toward Pusan. Both the declared objective and the actual deployments pointed toward eliminating the southern government and unifying the peninsula under northern control. The United Nations Security Council condemned the armed crossing in Resolution 82 on June 25 and authorized member states to provide military assistance in Resolution 83 on July 7. The United States then deployed air, naval, and ground forces under that authority. The Inchon landing and northward advance brought United Nations forces close to the Chinese border, while aircraft of the Nineteenth Air Force entered northeastern China. Beijing consequently decided in October to intervene under the name Chinese People’s Volunteers, and the Soviet Union expanded aviation and logistical assistance, turning an initial northern offensive into a prolonged war of attrition.
impact: 戰爭直接改變了朝鮮半島的軍事與政治結構。北韓初期憑藉繳獲物資維持攻勢，但聯合國建立海上封鎖後，進口、燃料和軍械補充受到限制；B-29與B-26反覆轟炸鐵路樞紐、橋梁、機場、燃料庫與軍工設施，第七十七特遣艦隊的艦載機則攻擊北部道路、鐵路和補給點，破壞了鐵路運輸與工業生產能力。地面戰的結果是北韓軍與志願軍被逐出南方，聯軍未能占據整個北方，半島遂沿三十八度線形成長期對峙。國際層面，中美在地面直接交戰，中蘇與美軍的空中接觸也使雙方關係長期惡化；1951年美日安保條約簽訂後，美軍在日本的存在與日本防衛體制更加制度化。這場戰爭證明聯合國框架可以組織多國地面、海空及後勤協同，也迫使美國重新安排西太平洋與東北亞的兵力部署。北部工業、運輸和城市設施遭受長期破壞，南北則各自維持常備軍與封閉邊界，之後的炮擊、滲透和空域事件持續影響區域安全。
impactEn: The war directly altered the military and political structure of the Korean peninsula. North Korea initially sustained its advance with captured supplies, but the United Nations maritime blockade restricted imports, fuel, and weapons. B-29 and B-26 aircraft repeatedly struck rail junctions, bridges, airfields, fuel depots, and military-industrial facilities, while carrier aircraft from Task Force 77 attacked roads, railways, and supply points in the north, disrupting transportation and industrial output. On the ground, North Korean and Chinese forces were expelled from the south, while United Nations forces failed to occupy the entire north. The peninsula consequently settled into a prolonged confrontation close to the thirty-eighth parallel. Internationally, Chinese and American troops fought directly, and Soviet and American aircraft also came into combat, worsening relations among the principal powers. After the United States-Japan Security Treaty was signed in 1951, American military presence in Japan and Japan’s defense institutions became more firmly institutionalized. The conflict demonstrated that the United Nations framework could organize multinational ground, air, naval, and logistical operations. It also prompted the United States to revise its force posture in the western Pacific and Northeast Asia. Northern industrial, transport, and urban infrastructure suffered prolonged destruction, while both Korean states maintained large standing armies and closed frontiers. Subsequent artillery fire, infiltration, and airspace incidents continued to affect regional security.
result: 1953年7月27日上午十時，朝鮮停戰協定在板門店簽署並生效，簽署方為聯合國軍總司令部、朝鮮人民軍和中國人民志願軍，大韓民國政府沒有成為直接簽署方。停火線大致沿北緯三十八度線配置，但經過雙方協商而有所調整，軍事分界線兩側各劃出約兩公里緩衝地帶，合計形成約四公里寬的非軍事區。協定規定停火、撤出協定區域、限制軍事部署、交換並分批遣返戰俘，並由中立國家監督委員會及聯合國軍總司令部共同核查執行。交換程序完成後，邊境由聯合國軍與北方部隊分區防守，非軍事區內設置哨站、軍事分界線及雙方軍事停火室。軍 事結果是北韓最初的南方攻勢完全失敗，朝鮮人民軍與志願軍退出韓國南部；聯軍同樣未能迫使北方接受政治統一，也沒有完成占領北方的目標。停戰協定不是和平條約，半島南北制度分裂、軍事對峙與大量部隊進駐仍然延續，之後的有限交火受到更嚴格的限制，但根本政治爭端並未因此解決。
resultEn: At 10:00 a.m. on July 27, 1953, the Korean Armistice Agreement was signed at Panmunjom and entered into force. The signatories were the United Nations Command, the Korean People’s Army, and the Chinese People’s Volunteers; the Republic of Korea government was not a direct signatory. The ceasefire line broadly followed the thirty-eighth parallel but incorporated mutually agreed adjustments. A buffer approximately two kilometers deep was established on each side of the Military Demarcation Line, creating a demilitarized zone about four kilometers wide in total. The agreement provided for a ceasefire, withdrawal from designated areas, restrictions on military deployments, and the phased repatriation of prisoners of war. Its implementation was checked by the Neutral Nations Supervisory Commission and United Nations Command. After the exchange process was completed, the border was divided into sectors guarded by United Nations and northern troops, with observation posts, the demarcation line, and bilateral military truce posts inside the demilitarized zone. Militarily, North Korea’s original southern offensive had failed completely, and both the Korean People’s Army and Chinese forces withdrew from South Korea. United Nations forces likewise failed to impose political reunification or complete the occupation of the north. The armistice was not a peace treaty. The division of the peninsula, its opposing military systems, and the concentration of forces continued, while later limited clashes became more tightly controlled even though the underlying political dispute remained unresolved.
